title: ao.erp-document/v1 — one declared ERP document type (frozen, issue #646)
description: The shape of one file under catalog/documents/: a single document type the module declares, its family, the epic child that delivers it, and the upstream doctype its PATTERN derives from (GR-10). One file per document type on purpose — the indexer indexes one knowledge item per file, so a query for a document type returns the entry that declares exactly that type, and nothing else can restate it: the module's own gate refuses a declaration-surface file that names a document fact. Document PARAMETERS (fields, and the workflow that moves the type between states) are ERP-02's deliverable and are deliberately absent here. Every object is closed (`additionalProperties: false`).

id.description: The document type's catalogue id. Unique across the catalogue and stable — consumers reference it.

name.description: The document type's declared name, as the catalogue spells it.

family.description: The capability id this document belongs to; must be declared in capabilities.json.

owning_issue.description: The epic child that delivers the type; must be declared in module-map.json.

upstream.description: The upstream entity the PATTERN was read from — a reference for the reviewer, never a copied artifact.
